children: Clear Channel Outdoor received its final regulatory clearance to allow its planned merger with Mubadala Capital.
The advertising company said it received clearance from the U.S. committee on foreign investment for the pending deal, which is now expected to close on Oct. 14.
Clear Channel stockholders will receive $2.43 a share in cash upon the completion of the merger. The company's stock will then cease trading publicly.
Mubadala, a state-owned wealth fund based in Abu Dhabi, said in February it would acquire Clear Channel in a $6.2 billion deal.
